fda: FDA is a federal agency in the Department of Health and Human Services established to regulate the release of new foods and health-related products.
FDA means the same as Food and Drug Administration.
fdic: FDIC is a federally sponsored corporation that insures accounts in national banks and other qualified institutions.
FDIC means the same as Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation.
fdr: FDR is 32nd President of the United States.
FDR means the same as Roosevelt or Franklin Roosevelt or Franklin Delano Roosevelt.
